description: Run `codavox deploy --wait` on the primary: r10k, seal, and return once the publisher serves the new code_id. Run as root.

environments.description: The environments to deploy, as r10k names them.

all.description: Deploy every environment r10k's sources define, instead of naming them.

modules.description: Re-resolve only these Puppetfile modules, by short name (apache, not puppetlabs/apache), leaving the rest of each environment as it is.
